title: Pressure-induced giant emission enhancement, large band gap narrowing and rich polymorphism in two-dimensional 1,2,4-triazolium lead bromide perovskite
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38514-38522
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07511K, Paper
Open Access

Mirosław Mączka, Filip Dybała, Artur P. Herman, Waldeci Paraguassu, Antonio José Barros dos Santos, Robert Kudrawiec
Application of external pressure leads to three pressure-induced phase transitions, allows band gap engineering and induces giant enhancement of the photoluminescence efficiency of the Tz2PbBr4 perovskite.
